guarantees.claim: keccak_run_req_d is set to 1 if sha3pad_keccak_run or sw_keccak_run is high, cleared to 0 if keccak_complete is high, otherwise it holds keccak_run_req_q; run_req_o directly follows keccak_run_req_d.
keccak_run is asserted when run_req_o is high, run_ack_i is high, and keccak_triggered_q is low.
keccak_triggered_d is set to 1 when keccak_run is high, cleared to 0 when keccak_complete is high, otherwise holds the current keccak_triggered_q.

assumptions.claim: The Keccak engine must assert keccak_complete after each keccak_run pulse to reset the triggered state and clear the request.
assumptions.risk: If keccak_complete never asserts, keccak_run_req_d and keccak_triggered_q stay high, stalling new operations and possibly locking the request line.

assumptions.claim: To avoid unintended retriggering after completion, run_ack_i must be deasserted before keccak_complete asserts if the request source does not intend a back-to-back operation.
assumptions.cond: When keccak_complete asserts while run_req_o is still active
assumptions.risk: If run_ack_i stays high, keccak_run fires again immediately, starting a new operation without an explicit new request pulse.

uncertain_points.claim: The combinational pulse keccak_run = run_req_o & run_ack_i & ~keccak_triggered_q may glitch if run_ack_i or run_req_o toggles within a clock cycle before keccak_triggered_q is updated.
uncertain_points.cond: During the clock cycle when run_ack_i first asserts while run_req_o is high and keccak_triggered_q is low
uncertain_points.risk: Glitches could be interpreted as multiple start pulses by the Keccak engine, leading to undefined behavior.
